youtube.title: Morning Prayer for Today | Psalm 23:1 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Start the day with this one.

"The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want." Psalm 23:1 (KJV)

A sheep doesn't plan the route. It follows the shepherd.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
